lines: [confident] Three texts. Two are scams. One is real. Watch.
[reading] One. USPS: your package is on hold. Pay a one dollar thirty redelivery fee.
[flat] Scam. USPS won't text you a link to pay a fee.
[reading] Two. Bank alert: verify your login here, or your account closes today.
[flat] Scam. A link plus a deadline. Classic.
[reading, smiling] Three. Mom: are you coming for Thanksgiving? Bring pie.
[warm] Real. No link. No money. Just pie.
[relieved] So the only thing I have to worry about is... pie?
